decisions: Clarify that repeated unknown-name ZK lookups are newly introduced. Stale alias refresh and negative caching remain separate scope choices.
evidence: PR 5314 and exact-head Linux gate solr-18606-alias-refresh-linux-gate-20261109-r2; 36 tests, negative proof, tidy and root check pass. GitHub Validate Changelog, Solr Tests via Crave, and Gradle Precommit require action.
findings: A missing-state refresh uses an unsynchronized ZooKeeper read; a lagging ensemble member can still miss a just-created collection. This is a source-and-guarantee inference, not a reproduced failure.

The mocked interruption bypasses getCollectionLive, which wraps actual missing-state ZooKeeper errors as BAD_REQUEST before the new provider catches; the test does not establish real error classification.

limitations: No builds or tests run on Windows; no quorum-lag reproduction or latency benchmark; no source or public PR writes.
test_review: Existing real-ZK fixture and watcher lock provide a meaningful deterministic local-view test; focused alias guard mock has mutation proof. The alias loop is redundant and class setup starts real ZooKeeper for mock-only tests. Avoid new infrastructure merely to remove startup.
